summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored destinations; player.state carries progression, gear, quests, run choices and resume location. Global scripts and shared registries coordinate play, while place scenes and simulations compose local spaces and stories, including Kyoto Dreams and Lumiria's countryside, town and barter economy.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes and anomalies; momentsV gates wall moments and room-prop regeneration, and objects.scene hosts shared controllers.
places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; Test Range has loot/enemy bays and HIT SQUAD pad.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations and Camp Amber crews; sim builds tunnels/doors and staffs camps; t5-a2 leads to Level 178.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office route; scenes own geometry, sims/cutscenes supply route props and local beats.
places/level1 + places/level4 + places/level26 (3D) - M.E.G. camps and office mazes; Level 26's S.S. Fun has cabin 23, Partygoer decks/lockdown and aboard gate; Level 1 includes Dina's radio.

places/level9 + places/level10 + places/level11 + places/level61 + places/level70 (3D) - Suburbs, Bumper Crop farm, city/Base Beta/strip mall/clinic, Snackrooms food court/checkpoint and Froidetown winter market; Level 10 entrances reach Lumiria.

places/level169 + places/level132 (3D) - Level 169 desert, Ferry's house/trail/pantry/basement and Field Office 7; Level 132, The Duchy of Morigont, includes Lumiria's town, collection-based barter, shops and generated countryside.

places/level178 + remaining authored level*/bonus places (3D) - Level 178 is Kyoto Dreams, with machiya/courtyard, residents, house quests and searchable containers; soaking in its spring can wake the player in Lumiria; other levels hold authored destinations.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera setup, ordered behaviors and input actions; fall-guard runs before movement and radio, barter and phone are player behaviors.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generation/tick behavior; places/level10/sim.js lays the Bumper Crop road and Archers' tower.
places/level169/config.yaml + scripts/terrain169.js and places/level132/config.yaml + scripts/terrain132.js - seeded height/material generators and place-specific terrain marks.
places/level169/sim.js + scripts/lib/data/level169.yml + house/Ferry/Friends/road/Robotics helpers - dynamic desert setpieces, cast schedules, routes, quests and units.
places/level132/sim.js + scripts/lib/data/level132.yml + scripts/lib/l132-*.js - local lay/tick orchestration for square, stalls, shops, land, people, Duke, quests and barter.
scripts/lib/l132-land.js + scripts/lib/data/l132-land.yml + art/l132-land/build.py - staged countryside/cottage props and authored model kit; level132 config supplies terrain, roads and meadow.

places/level178/config.yaml + scripts/terrain178.js + x0z0.scene + sim.js - terrain and authored Kyoto house, resident rounds, arrival quest, one-time finds, searchable containers and breakable sweep.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/ui.js - title/save lifecycle, expedition choices and shared HUD/menu surface; ui.js lazily mounts the barter and phone panels when their player-state flags are set.
shared: scripts/lib/places.js - canonical per-place names, labels and HUD titles; consumed by feed, quest names and scripts/ui.js; registers Level 132 as The Duchy of Morigont.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - common pursuit/lurk/wake/retreat/bite behavior configured by l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js; companion.js/carry.js handle followers and held-prop transfers.
scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - separate Bonus shared-room routing and Hub tunnel/door/key registry; t5-a2 maps to Level 178.
scripts/lib/containment.js - Level 109 persistent pen/loose-foe, open-door and remembered-door-position books; sim supplies room IDs/boxes and spawnFoe adapter.
scripts/lib/pg-society.js + scripts/lib/data/pg-society.yml - Level 26 Partygoer roles/routes, sight-bound relay and deck alert/search/recovery; partygoers.js owns actor behavior/traps.

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data - shared usable-prop/container migration and geometry specs; scripts/interact.js dispatches; scripts/lib/voices.js resolves NPC voices and recorded takes.

scripts/lib/barter-deal.js - shared Lumiria barter inventory, valuation and balanced-deal rules; consumed by scripts/lib/l132-barter.js, scripts/barter.js and scripts/barter-ui.js; scripts/lib/screen.js coordinates phone with the other wrist panels.
notableExports: scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; per-level adapters retain level-specific cell/block rules.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - stepAmbushSmiler; l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js expose update with separate configurations.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.

scripts/lib/quests.js - journal/advancement/reward helpers; containment.js - pen/door operations; ch2-quest.js - Chapter 2 stages/dialogue helpers; scripts/field-fixture.js - startRestPose, finishRest, finishHeat, ears.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js - OPTS, DEFAULTS, PICK_DEFAULTS, RATE, PRESETS, runOf, needsMul, sanityMul, noStory, noNpcs, cleanPick, KEEP, SKIP; scripts/main-menu.js - SLOTS.

scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, rollItem, gateItems, crate/level-specific rolls; scripts/lib/l132-barter.js - dukeOffer/barter/offer helpers; scripts/lib/barter-deal.js - mine/open/deal/offerOf/askOf; scripts/barter.js and scripts/phone.js - onInput/update handlers, phone also onPhoneSent.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable player.state progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, currency and related progress.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats them; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates xpCurve progression.
scripts/lib/modifiers.js - player.state bookBonuses/readBooks/genericBooksRead/effects and modifier derivation; scripts/lib/clothes.js owns worn gear records whose passives feed modifiers.
scripts/lib/manuals.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.recipes stores learned recipe IDs; legacy player.state.manuals grants all recipes of those kinds.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - player.state.run owns expedition picks; run options determine story/NPC presence and hunger/thirst/sanity drain multipliers.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - SQL saves table owns named save-slot snapshots by player owner and slot; player.state remains live/current run state.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js + scripts/lib/tutorial.js - player.state.t0n/t0cut/t0Done/t0fade track tutorial beats; guideSeen/guideTip/guideMuted track Field Guide state/preferences.

scripts/barter.js owns the active player.state.bt table; scripts/lib/barter-deal.js transfers traded goods into player.state.l132 bag/stocks and sets player.state.phone on phone acquisition; scripts/phone.js owns phoneOpen/tab/recipient/read/send UI state, while player.mail and friends/presence are external player services.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV, radio, barter and phone behaviors; scripts/interact.js finds focused tagged props and dispatches their actions.

templates/player.js runs scripts/fall-guard.js before movement; place changes hold velocity for ground streaming, grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; body3 uses camera aim + combat-anims.yml for third-person pose.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on place arrival.

scripts/main-menu-ui.js actions → scripts/main-menu.js → player.state.run or SQL saves; new-run reset retains NEW_KEEP screen/menu/save-list keys and clears character state; after t0Done pause Return routes to Bonus Rooms.
scripts/main-menu.js forces player/world bodyStyle to furry and ignores style actions; scripts/lib/critter-model.js setStyle always clears HUMAN, so character models are furry-only.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js → main-menu story gates Dina/Chapter 2/cutscenes; global sim.js removes npc-tagged people only when all players in a place choose noNpcs, and Phoebe only when all choose noStory.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; threshold door handlers call carryAcross → held props and nearby following companions cross; Bonus/world/room links are excluded.

scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone (Level 178 maps to l178_house; Level 132 to l132_lumiria); scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles, markers and compass place names.

scripts/level-door.js onTriggerEnter resolves threshold ID/partner → destination marker and carryAcross; l132-tree-exit returns to level10#l10-from-l132, while Level 10's hollow tree and Archers' tower thresholds enter level132#l132-arrive.

places/level132/sim.js routes l132:barter stall presses and keeper dialogue offers → scripts/lib/l132-barter.js opens player.state.bt; scripts/barter.js handles each player's give/take/haggle/deal actions, scripts/lib/barter-deal.js enforces balance, and scripts/ui.js lazily renders barter-ui.js.

world.config.yaml M/phone action → scripts/phone.js checks possession and scripts/lib/screen.js wrist-panel exclusivity, then phone-ui.js renders mail/friends/texting; mail:send job → onPhoneSent, and phone.js update buzzes for unread mail across levels.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon + places/level61/sim.js and scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - authored commercial interiors and simulated staff/services; menus/staff vary by venue and Level 6.1 fixtures are fitted separately.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes a table with separately fitted chairs; field-fix routines preserve legacy builds.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/ballistics.js + scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/loot.js - weapon variants share combat and rarity/level gates; place-specific loot pools and local weapon lists vary by environment.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait selection; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.

scripts/lib/l169-road.js + scripts/lib/l169-road-geo.js + scripts/lib/l169-travel.js + scripts/lib/l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.

places/level132/sim.js + l132-{stalls,shops,land,people,duke,quests,barter}.js + scripts/lib/barter-deal.js - Lumiria's staged land/town and keeper trades share an eight-category goods system; first item gift, then balanced no-coin barter with one skill/attribute-based haggle and per-keeper stock.

scripts/phone.js + scripts/phone-ui.js + scripts/lib/screen.js - one shared wrist phone across levels; Lumiria-traded phones unlock M, mail texts and friend presence feed the UI, with signal bars varying by place.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs and destinations together. t5-a2 is OPEN to Level 178; l178-to-hub pairs with the sim-created hub-from-l178 marker.

Level 13's building shell is authored in cells/x0z0.scene; sim.js returns if l13-floor is absent and no longer regenerates the shell. Preserve matching floor ID and scene wall/threshold geometry; LETH remains in player.state.leth13.

Level 169 uses x/z with north at -z and 1:10 map scale; terrain marks, track, house, road sites, Field Office 7 and ship berth must align. level169.yml holds tuned positions/rules; sim layout version and well version are separate.

Level 178 positions in level178.yml use metres, north = -Z, house floor y=0.45; preserve shell2 frames/pivots, usable IDs/coordinates and basin collider dimensions. Cabinet IDs carry container state/items directly; pool l178 yields Kyoto-specific loot.

Level 132 uses metres, north = -Z and town ground y=0; keep terrain marks/config, l132-land.yml positions, scene anchors and generated props aligned. Barter is currency-free: bag/stocks and the active table are player state, and phones acquired in Lumiria enable M elsewhere; Level 10's l10-from-l132 and Level 132's tree-exit/arrival markers pair across the boundary.
